prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE realistic-to-produce indie game visual prototype screenshot for a serious hospital management mobile game called 梅奥诊所. This is an intentionally MUCH SIMPLER art direction than architectural-render hospital concept art. Landscape 2:1 screenshot, edge-to-edge game world, no device frame, no montage.
Art style: genuine flat 2D TOP-DOWN tilemap and sprite game. Camera looks almost straight down, with just the small amount of front-facing sprite visibility typical of classic top-down management games. Orthographic, no perspective, NO isometric cubes, no exposed building facades, no rendered 3D, no photographic surfaces, no complex light/shadow. Crisp economical contours, flat color fills, at most two or three tones per object, limited subtle ground shadows. Restrained small palette: warm off-white, light concrete gray, muted sage, navy blue, desaturated terracotta. Serious and clear rather than cute. Clean sprite work comparable in production scope to a small indie 2D management game. No pixel-noise textures; shape repetition is desirable.
World: a modest rectangular streetfront clinic covering about 70 percent of frame. Floor made from repeated square modules. Street and sidewalk form a narrow strip at bottom, two simple trees at side. The clinic has 5 rooms with unambiguous doors into a horizontal corridor: reception and waiting area at entrance; two simple consultation rooms; small treatment/preparation room; staff room. Include one small unfinished empty expansion area clearly separated. Walls thin and low, completely avoid occlusion.
Furniture MUST be built from visibly reusable simple sprites: identical desks, identical two-color waiting chairs, simple examination couches, rectangular cabinets, monitor icon, sink. No tiny equipment details or decorative posters. Sparse furniture with enough room to walk. Five simplified human sprites approximately 35-45 pixels tall at a 1600-wide canvas, small full-body people with ordinary adult proportions and two-tone hair and clothing, same reusable sprite body, no detailed faces. One clinician and patient in consultation, nurse in corridor, two patients waiting. A few understated wall or floor color differences help identify rooms. Do not cover rooms with text labels.
Show a coherent buildable GAME SCREEN, not a floorplan blueprint and not a website. Most visual interest comes from the readable rooms and little people. UI: exact small text "梅奥诊所" at top left, "09:20" and "¥180,000" at top right; three small dark navy square pictogram controls bottom left labeled "医院" "团队" "事务"; discreet plus/minus at bottom right. No gauges, charts, dashboard panels, status cards, chat windows, explanations, title headings, promotional text, coins, task bubbles, glow, gradients, cinematic shadows, medical drama or exaggerated cartoons. Avoid polished architectural presentation. Do not add commentary outside the screen. The result must visibly demonstrate a financially achievable reusable 2D sprite-and-tile art system while remaining attractive and professional.
